# find_version { #labdata.core.find_version }

```python
labdata.core.find_version(entry, ref)
```

Resolve a version reference against a file's history.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**entry**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Entry](`labdata.model.Entry`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Entry whose history to search.

<code>[**ref**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[str](`str`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A commit sha or unique prefix of one, a tag name, or ``latest`` for the most recent version.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[Version](`labdata.model.Version`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   The matching version.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[LookupError](`LookupError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If no version matches. The message lists recent versions.
